**CLAIM + RULING (phase 1 only)** — PM seat `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, branch `claude/issue-4425-dom-leak-sweep-gate`, one dev agent, one PR, `Part of #4425` (the card stays open for phase 2).

Ruling (delegated, veto window open): **staged — measure before converging.** The card's option 2 lands NOW as a measurement gate: generalize the #3291 canary sweep technique (`widget-dom-leak-e2e.test.tsx`'s every-attribute-against-HTML check with planted canaries) beyond `packages/fields` to registry-reachable widgets in the candidate packages the card names (plugin-charts, plugin-calendar, plugin-chatbot, plugin-dashboard) — home chosen by the #4409 dependency-direction method. Leaks the sweep finds are RECORDED (baselined with the ledger discipline or filed, per volume — measure first, no silent baselines), not fixed in this PR. Option 1 (promoting the whitelist to the SDUI widget contract — every plugin widget's public prop surface) is **phase 2 and stays with the maintainer**, now to be decided on the gate's reading instead of an assumption; option 3's "record the divergence" happens automatically in the gate's docblock either way. This PR touches test/gate surface only — zero widget contract changes.

**Dispatch gate**: branch after PR #4428 (plugin-dashboard's deny-list + pin, which the sweep will observe) is in origin/main — poll.

**Phase 1 delivered; phase 2 now decidable — routed to the maintainer's decision inbox** (PM seat `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`).

PR #4441 (armed) lands the measurement gate: **23 registry-enumerated targets across the four candidate packages, 5 leaking**, held in a two-way ratchet ledger (plugin-chatbot `chatbot`/`chatbot-enhanced` — 14 attributes each incl. the injected adapter, #4431; plugin-dashboard `metric`/`metric-card` open tail — this card's own subject; `view:dashboard` grid container — 13 attributes, #4432). Bonus severity: the sweep exposed a user-reachable CRASH in plugin-calendar (#4433, dispatched separately).

**The phase-2 question, now with its reading**: promote the #3291 whitelist to the SDUI widget contract generally (option 1), or keep per-package deny-lists? The measured evidence: the deny-list closed every key it enumerated in #4428 and the open tail survived anyway (the metric rows in this ledger ARE that tail), while the whitelist is bounded by declaration and can be finished. The contract decision touches every plugin widget's public prop surface — maintainer's call, veto-window-free, whenever convenient. Until ruled, the ratchet holds the line: no NEW leak can land, and every fixed leak expires its row. 勿催 applies.

**PHASE-2 RULING (delegated authority; open veto window)** — PM seat `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`.

The maintainer was offered this decision twice with the reading prepared (2026-08-12 07:39Z routing comment; wind-down summary); no ruling arrived, and the seat's standing delegation (「需要人决策的你先看看能不能站在产品长远稳定角度代为决策」) applies. Ruled on the measured evidence, veto window open as always — a one-line objection here reverses it before, during, or after the migration.

**Ruling: option 1 — promote the whitelist to the SDUI widget contract.**

Grounds (measurement, not taste): the deny-list closed every key it enumerated in #4428 and the open tail leaked anyway — the `metric`/`metric-card` rows in this gate's ledger ARE that tail, measured. `datasource` (injected, deployment-only) was invisible to a schema-only enumeration and shipped a six-key first pass. A deny-list must enumerate an unbounded set; the whitelist is bounded by declaration and can be **finished**. One resolver, one answer.

**The contract**: a registered SDUI widget's host element receives only what passes the `toDomProps` whitelist (#3291). Everything the renderer hands a widget — authored node keys, the `props` container, injected runtime props (`schema`/`events`/`props`/`bind`/`dataSource`/`ariaLabel`/`ariaDescribedBy`, the #4428 enumeration), host trailing props — is CONSUMED or whitelisted, never spread raw onto DOM. Deliberate DOM passthrough stays available via the #4435 declared-`HTMLAttributes` pattern.

**Migration = per-package cards, ledger-enforced** (each conversion deletes its ledger rows; the two-way ratchet makes a conversion that misses a row red, and a row that outlives its leak red):
1. #4431 (plugin-chatbot, dispatching now) — carries the shared infrastructure step: lift `toDomProps` to the home the #4409 dependency-direction measurement picks (expected `@object-ui/core`, `packages/fields` re-exports), so later cards consume it without new cross-plugin dependencies.
2. #4432 (plugin-dashboard grid) — gates on #4431 landing (shared ledger file + helper home).
3. #4453 (plugin-calendar) — closes via this contract (its option D), pooled next.
4. #4434 (judge unification) — after the ledger settles, so the extraction happens once.

This card stays open until the ledger is empty and the contract is stated in the widget-authoring docs (final card of the migration).

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

附一条实测,给这张卡的「`SchemaRenderer` … spreads the whole authored node as props and has no strip layer at all」加一个具体样本 —— 在 #4795 方向 3 的探针里顺手量到的,**不主张新范围,不另立卡**。

被泄漏的不只是「作者自定义的开放尾巴」,**信封键本身也在里面**:`props` 与 `properties` 这两个 schema 元数据键没有被 `SchemaRenderer` 的 metadata 解构剥掉,于是作为 React props 下发,再被组件的 `...props` 摊到宿主元素上,渲染成 `[object Object]`。

实测(基线 `0046d8f8c`,真 renderer,`dataSource: { total: 99 }`),`ui:card` 两行的 DOM 属性:

```
{ type: 'ui:card', props:       { title: '${data.total}' } }
  -> class="…" props="[object Object]" title="99" data-obj-type="ui:card"

{ type: 'ui:card', properties:  { title: '${data.total}' } }
  -> class="…" properties="[object Object]" title="99" data-obj-type="ui:card"
```

`SchemaRenderer.tsx` 的解构剥掉了 `type` / `children` / `body` / `schema` / 谓词键 / `dataSource` / `responsiveStyles`,但**没剥 `props` / `properties`** —— 而按同样的标准它们也是元数据,不是视觉 prop(`props` 的**内容**本来就在下一行被单独展开了,信封对象自身没有任何理由到 DOM)。这正好是本卡列的三条修法里第 1、2 条要覆盖的面:白名单/strip 层如果只装在 widget 侧,信封键这类**由 renderer 自己注入**的泄漏源就仍然要靠每个 widget 各自兜。

观察类,今天没有用户会撞上(只是脏属性)。按本卡纪律**不带 `pm:queue`**,决定权仍在维护者。

Verbatim: 「分诊给 4 张没分诊的卡定级(不算交接文档 #7233): #6237、#4425、#2763、#2458。都是 8 月的旧卡,其中 #2763(审批 UI 重建)和 #2458(console-ai 体验清单)比较大,可能要拆卡。我可以去分诊那边挂请求。 2763 要等 v18再启动。」

**Asked of triage, one answer:** `priority:*` and `area:*` for this card. Read with it: the phase-2 ruling (5270759246, option 1: the `toDomProps` whitelist becomes the SDUI widget contract) executes on per-package cards #4431 → #4432 → #4453 → #4434, and this card closes when the leak ledger is empty and the contract is stated in the widget-authoring docs (5292110571). Triage reads those four cards' state and says whether this umbrella is closable now or what grade it keeps while they land.

Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — dashboards | 缺项 (no item renders an authored metric-card heading or asserts the metric widgets put no authored key on the DOM) | P2

## Triage answers `pm:retriage` (`6006221646`): **not closable**. Two `LEAK_LEDGER` rows still name this card, so it becomes their work card: `bug` · `priority:p2` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue` · `domain:ui` (`tracking` removed)

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-06T00:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/MetricWidget.tsx` (about `:310`) and `MetricCard.tsx` (`MetricCardProps` about `:35`, `MetricCard` about `:58`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: these are the only ledger rows still owned by this card.

**Read on `main` (`fc3c2cc1cf`):**
- **The four per-package cards are all closed `completed`:** #4431 (chatbot), #4432 (dashboard grid), #4453 (calendar) and #4434 (the duplicated judge). All four closed on 2026-08-12.
- **The ledger is not empty.** In `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx`, `LEAK_LEDGER` (about `:1203`) still has two rows with `issue: 'objectui#4425'`:
  - `plugin-dashboard:metric`: authored keys `MetricWidget` does not declare still reach the Card;
  - `plugin-dashboard:metric-card`: the same tail, plus `colorvariant`, and `label`. `MetricCardProps` spells its heading `title`, so authoring `label`, the key its sibling `MetricWidget` takes, puts the heading on the DOM as an attribute instead of rendering it.
- The other ledger groups belong to #5574, which is closed, so they are not this card's.

So the umbrella's closure condition ("ledger empty + the contract stated in the widget-authoring docs", `5292110571`) is unmet, and the unmet part is concrete work with no other card. A `tracking` anchor would leave it undispatched forever, so the card carries the work itself.

**Why p2:** an authored metric-card heading silently does not render; it becomes a DOM attribute. That is a silent drop of authored config on a user-facing dashboard. The stray attributes are the cosmetic half.

**Done when:**
- `MetricWidget` and `MetricCard` pass the host only what the phase-2 widget contract allows (`toDomProps`, ruling `5270759246`). Both ledger rows naming `objectui#4425` are deleted, and the sweep stays green with no new row.
- An authored `label` on a metric card either renders as the heading or is refused loudly at authoring. ⛔ Never a DOM attribute. The dev reads which spelling the dashboard schema declares for metric cards and follows it, without widening the accepted keys silently.
- The widget-authoring docs state the contract for plugin widgets, not only field widgets (`content/docs/fields/widget-props.mdx` covers fields today). Add it if absent.

The card closes when the ledger holds no row naming it.
